evidenceBoundary: Public primary-source review only. Terms identify Ahoy Labs, Inc. and backyard.ai. Homepage says shut down and self-service download window closed. Historical documentation survives in search-indexed copies or older web-open results; several live documentation routes return closure notices. Capability statuses describe evidence, not current availability. No accounts, purchases, inference, installation, production access, browser automation, device tests or source-code inspection. Benefits are untested design judgments.

tradeoffs: Current homepage reports shutdown, closed normal cloud features and closed self-service downloads. Historical strengths are not a current availability recommendation.
Desktop application is deprecated and unsupported. Local inference does not establish maintained self-hosting or post-closure tethering.
Historical tethering required a running desktop, the same Backyard account and Backyard web routing.
Earlier closure notice limited BYAF coverage to compatible single-character chats; unavailable older images were separately listed.
Earlier archive requests ended November 4, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific; downloads ended November 6, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific. Homepage now reports the window closed.
Expert sampler documentation establishes described controls, not present availability on all clients or models.
Historical context eviction removes old history. Keyword lore does not guarantee long-story recall.
